summary: Iteration 5 — multi-tenant (business + memberships + invites) end-to-end. BACKEND: added /app/backend/tests/test_multitenant.py (19 tests across 11 classes) covering: separate owners get separate business_ids, /auth/me returns business_id+role=owner, data isolation (Business A cannot GET/PUT/DELETE B's customer/pet/booking — all 404), services/customers/staff listings never leak B's data, cross-business booking/payment creation rejected 400, invite + accept flow (invite_link + token returned, GET /invites/{token} returns business_name/role, POST /invites/accept creates user+membership and returns JWT with business_id/role=staff, staff can hit /customers /pets /bookings /dashboard /staff, re-accept returns 404 idempotency, staff invite from staff account returns 403), role gating — staff hitting /billing/checkout, /billing/portal, /billing/verify, /staff/invite, /staff/{id}/deactivate|reactivate, DELETE /staff/{id}, DELETE /invites/{id} ALL 403, 10-staff bulk invite share one business subscription, deactivation blocks protected endpoints (403) AND blocks login (403) when all memberships deactivated, reactivation restores access, trial expiry (trial_ends_at past → entitled=false), shared entitlement (owner+staff see same subscription_status), file cross-business access denied (403, upload-dependent — skipped only if storage unreachable), legacy demo@petadmin.app still logs in, has role=owner+business_id and 5+ seeded customers, Stripe checkout returns stripe URL for owner. FULL BACKEND SUITE: 56/56 pass (new 19 + 37 pre-existing). FRONTEND (web smoke @ 390x844): logged in as demo owner — /staff shows invite form + Send invite + Copy-link row after send; /invite/{token} shows 'Happy Tails Grooming' + password form + Join team; accepting lands on dashboard; new staff More tab correctly HIDES Subscription row, keeps Staff & invites row, shows STAFF pill; /staff for staff user shows 'Only the business owner can invite or remove staff.' and NO invite form. BUG FOUND + FIXED: GET /api/invites/{token} and POST /api/invites/accept returned 500 TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at server.py:994 and :1010 — same pattern as iter4 billing bug. Fixed in-place by coercing expires_at to UTC-aware before comparison. All 19 new tests now pass. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

minor.issue: FIXED by testing agent. expires_at datetime from Mongo is tz-naive, compared to tz-aware now_utc() → 500 TypeError. Added `if expires_at.tzinfo is None: expires_at = expires_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` before the `<` check. Same class of bug as iter4 billing. Recommend initialising AsyncIOMotorClient(tz_aware=True) in server.py:49 so every datetime round-tripped from Mongo is aware by construction.

action_items: (low) Harden tz handling globally — pass tz_aware=True to AsyncIOMotorClient in server.py:49 so all datetime fields returned from Mongo are offset-aware; this prevents further occurrences of the invite/billing tz bug pattern.
(optional) Convert the staff_sess fixture in test_multitenant.py::TestRoleGating to a classmethod to silence the Pytest-10 deprecation warning (functional, cosmetic only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:994 and :1010 were tz-naive-vs-aware comparisons — identical pattern to the already-fixed billing bug; the whole file still relies on local .replace(tzinfo=UTC) coercion instead of a tz_aware Mongo client, so this class of regression remains latent (e.g. any future `trial_ends_at`/`expires_at` comparison).

server.py:949 invite_staff declares `request: Request = None` as a trailing param — works today but FastAPI dependency ordering would be safer with `request: Request` before the body param (not blocking).

rca_of_issue: Invite endpoints returned 500 TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. ROOT CAUSE: db.invites stores expires_at as datetime (tz-aware when written via now_utc()+timedelta), but AsyncIOMotorClient was constructed without tz_aware=True so BSON round-trip strips tzinfo on read. The subsequent `expires_at < now_utc()` compared naive-vs-aware → TypeError. FIX APPLIED to server.py GET /invites/{token} (lines 993-998) and POST /invites/accept (lines 1009-1013): if expires_at.tzinfo is None → expires_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) before comparing. Verified by test_multitenant.py::TestStaffInvites::test_owner_invite_and_accept_flow and the frontend smoke accepting a real invite.
